name: bjsonvalue-test-248ac7be19/get-array-out-of-bound-p.bal
reason: The JSON list constructor, cast to json[], and array member access are supported without applicable restrictions. Accessing index 5 of a three-element array must panic with the asserted IndexOutOfRange reason and index/size detail. The lang.array-qualified runtime error arises from supported indexing; it is not an invocation of an unlisted langlib function.
test_design_notes: The @panic annotation asserts the out-of-range indexing error, before the outer string cast can execute. No @args or @output assertions are present.
